resources.string: Runs JavaScript and TypeScript with the independent Bun engine in an isolated Android process

Put \"bun\"; alone on the first line of a JS or TS file, then run it from AutoJs6 as usual. Each run executes that single file only: npm dependencies are never auto-installed, and AutoJs6 built-in functions are not available inside Bun scripts.
Bun Runtime is busy. Wait for the current script to finish or cancel it, then try again.
Bun execution failed. Check the diagnostic details and try again.
The Bun execution request is invalid. Check the request settings and update AutoJs6 and the plugin if needed.
Bun exited with code %1$d. Check the script error output.
Bun output exceeded the configured byte limit. Reduce stdout and stderr output, then run the script again.
This Bun x86_64 build cannot run with %1$d-byte process pages; its JavaScriptCore limit is %2$d bytes. Use a compatible device. APK alignment alone does not resolve this limit.
Access to Bun Runtime requires the AutoJs6 plugin permission.
The source exceeds the %1$d-byte limit. Reduce the script size and try again.
The Bun process could not start. Check the diagnostic details and device compatibility.
Bun execution timed out. Shorten the task or adjust the execution timeout within the allowed limit.
Bun Runtime is unavailable. Check device compatibility and reinstall the plugin if its files are incomplete.
If Bun Runtime is not activated or enabled, open Plugin Center in AutoJs6, authorize and enable the plugin, and use Activate if the host shows it.
The official plugin requires Android 13 (API 33) or later. Android 9 through 12L cannot run it; lowering the manifest requirement does not make the runtime compatible.
Messages use the Android language setting for the plugin. Low-level diagnostic details and Bun output may remain in English.
